reason: At ClientPermissionsV2.java:217, getResourceTypeResource returns null when the realm has no 'Clients' resource, or when supportsAuthorizationSchema is false (AdminPermissionsSchema.java:117-118, 144-152). Line 219 then calls findByResource, which reads resource.getId() with no null check (JPAPolicyStore.java:215, StoreFactoryCacheSession.java:938/946), so it throws a NullPointerException. Existing realms never get the new resource or scopes because init returns early when the client already exists (AdminPermissionsSchema.java:226-228), and the patch adds no migration.
